messages.subject: International Mining Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Scotford Fennessy Team,

Your executive-search and specialist recruitment work across mining, construction and resources makes this a focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive communications.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where responsible mining, institutional trust, regulatory execution and operating strategy intersect. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate or rotational assignments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
